johnson_groundwater_test.statement: Johnson et al. (2021) report that filling can harm groundwater-influenced sites. Directional prediction: high baseflow index implies larger completed-year error.

reference_versus_disturbed.statement: Directional prediction: reference basins are easier than disturbed ones.

expected_signs.BFI_AVE: negative: groundwater damps the shared atmospheric signal donors carry
expected_signs.CONTACT: negative: longer subsurface contact time decouples the stream from weather
expected_signs.STOR_NID_2009: negative: upstream storage imposes a release regime donors do not share
expected_signs.DRAIN_SQKM: positive: thermal inertia makes large rivers track regional rather than local forcing
